items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Parker got up on the stand... he said, "Play the Kansas City Blues."

ctx.x: I said, "No, man, not the condition you're in." He said, "I'll do it, Mary. Anything you tell me I'll do." He said, "You know I'm not allowed to play in Birdland or any of the clubs." You know, that's during that period. So I told him, "Get up on the stand and let the people see how great you are." The place was really packed because see a lot of the people had followed me from the East Side. Some of these people had been to a ballet or something this night and they came in.
